prompts.name: field-opportunity-analysis
prompts.title: Find opportunities in a technology field
prompts.description: Analyse one or more technology or research fields with analyze_field, then write ranked, evidence-backed product and business opportunities (why now, capital needed, who to talk to).

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Fields or technologies, one per line or separated by semicolons, e.g. "sodium-ion battery; solid state battery".

arguments.name: audience
arguments.description: Who the analysis is for, e.g. "a seed-stage founder", "a corporate R&D team". Default: founders, R&D leaders and investors.

prompts.name: idea-validation
prompts.title: Validate a product or research idea
prompts.description: Check an idea with validate_idea (how much research already covers it, who is working on it, closest prior work, related patents), then assess novelty, timing, capital, risks and next steps.

arguments.name: idea
arguments.description: The idea in a sentence or two, e.g. "a window that generates solar power with perovskite tandem cells".

tools.name: get_trade_show_exhibitors
tools.title: Get trade show exhibitor lists (booths and contacts)
tools.description: Exhibitor lists of trade shows as B2B leads: company, booth and hall, email, phone, website, address, socials and categories. 91 built-in shows (e.g. medica, sema-show, nab-show, fabtech, ish, automechanika, wtm-london, orgatec, eurotier, wine-paris, biofach) or any exhibitor-list link or show homepage on Messe Frankfurt, Messe Düsseldorf, Koelnmesse, NürnbergMesse, Newfront/ExpoPlatform, RX, Map Your Show, a2z / A2Z Connect, Swapcard or Corussoft; the link's own show and year are used. Contact coverage depends on what the organiser publishes. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/exhibition-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.002 per exhibitor; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

shows.description: Built-in show ids, e.g. ["medica","sema-show"]. The Actor README lists all ids.

urls.description: Links to any show's exhibitor list or exhibitor search page (or its homepage).

include_contacts.description: Open each exhibitor profile for email, phone, website, address and socials. Off = names and booths only (faster).

changes_only.description: Only exhibitors that are new, changed (old and new booth, email, phone, website, address) or removed since the last call with the same shows. Removed ones need the whole list, so it ignores max_items for that.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

annotations.title: Get trade show exhibitor lists (booths and contacts)

tools.name: find_events
tools.title: Find upcoming events (Luma, Eventbrite, Meetup)
tools.description: Upcoming events by topic and city, or from Luma / Eventbrite / Meetup links (or any page with schema.org events): name, dates, venue with address and coordinates, organiser, hosts, ticket prices, free/sold-out and attendee count, in one format. Use for event prospecting, sponsorships and community research. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/events-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.001 per event; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

location.description: City in plain words (e.g. "London", "Bengaluru") or "online". Luma searches within a city.

urls.description: Luma city/category/calendar/event links, Eventbrite searches or events, Meetup search or group links, or any events page.

sources.description: Sites searched for `searches` (default all three). Meetup knows about 70 big cities by name; others as "City, CC" (e.g. "Lyon, FR").

include_details.description: Open each event for organiser, tickets and full description. Off = faster.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

annotations.title: Find upcoming events (Luma, Eventbrite, Meetup)
